conventions.eta: N for odd N; N/2 for even N
conventions.universal_GS: equal PS levels and one residue rho: A4=A2L=A2R=rho mod eta; A_grav=24rho mod eta

assumptions: The three Q families have one charge q and the three Qc families one charge qc. A generic 3x3 Q_i H Qc_j matrix enforces this family universality.
Q H Qc, ThetaPlus A16 Bbar16, and ThetaMinus C16 Dbar16 are allowed W terms.
r(ThetaPlus)=t and r(ThetaMinus)=-t; no value of r(H)=h is assumed.
The three PS factors have equal level and one universal GS residue, so A4=A2L=A2R mod eta.
Any 126/bar126 or other complete-Spin10 threshold contributes the same common shift C to all three mixed rows.
degree20_forcing_theorem.conclusion: No Z_N^R satisfying these equal-level universal mixed-anomaly conditions can forbid both first oriented degree-20 local invariants.
deduction: Adding the two differences gives 12-4h=0 mod 2eta.
Substitution gives 12q+6-4t=0 mod 2eta and therefore mod N.
The conjugate equation is 12qc+6+4t=0 mod N.
escape_routes_not_solutions: family-nonuniversal R charges together with a rebuilt flavour/Yukawa texture
nonuniversal localized GS axions or boundary counterterms with explicit quantized couplings
a changed light chiral spectrum or changed required mass/Yukawa couplings
an R-breaking rather than exact-R mass threshold

fail_closed_boundary.reason: Integrated residues are necessary arithmetic only. Bulk hypermultiplets, orbifold parities, boundary gauginos, heavy KK thresholds, the gravity/radion sector, and the actual Spin^Z_N global structure can change or obstruct the localized/global answer.

assumptions: ThetaPlus and ThetaMinus are R-neutral, so their nonzero VEVs preserve the full Z_N^R.
Delta126 and DeltaBar126 are R-neutral and SDelta has charge two.
The displayed four-dimensional zero-mode/brane spectrum is used; localized KK and gravity sectors are omitted.
The mu bilinear H H is required to be absent.
finite_integrated_search.qualification: Every candidate still allows the forced degree-20 oriented W operator and is not a 5D anomaly certificate.

massive_packet_no_go.claim: An ordinary symmetry-preserving massive vectorlike PS packet cannot repair the congruence no-go.
massive_packet_no_go.complex_pair_proof: For X in R and Xbar in barR, an invariant nondegenerate mass requires rX+rXbar=2 mod N. Its mixed contribution is T(R)[(rX-1)+(rXbar-1)]=0 mod eta.
massive_packet_no_go.real_or_pseudoreal_qualification: A permitted Majorana/Pfaffian block obeys the analogous mass-determinant condition; its perturbative mixed anomaly shift is trivial modulo eta. A nontrivial gapped topological sector would be new microscopic input, not an ordinary massive matter packet.
massive_packet_no_go.smallest_honest_rep_comment: A (1,2,2) is honest under the PS diagonal Z2 and can change SU2L/R rows only if it remains R-chiral. If its exact-R mass is allowed, its anomaly shift is trivial; if not, it is an added light field or needs R breaking.
